title: Decapod cloud integration through Dactyl and Propodus
intent: Make backend=cloud a truthful Decapod runtime selection through the existing Dactyl boundary, with no per-query backend inputs, local/mock troubleshooting proof, and a single publishable PR.
proof_hooks: focused Rust tests, cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy, decapod validate, hosted PR checks
stop_conditions: Do not claim live hosted stability or close issues whose proof belongs to Dactyl/Propodus deployment; stop on a Decapod decision gate or contract mismatch.
deferred_questions: Live Neon/Vercel deployment parity and credentials are intentionally unavailable in this run; retain as a downstream proof gate and do not claim hosted stability.

forbidden_paths: Do not mutate Dactyl or Propodus repositories; do not add per-query backend parameters; do not hand-edit .decapod generated state; do not work on protected master.

phases.name: Contract and issue reconciliation
phases.description: Review live Decapod dactyl/propodus issues and freeze the Dactyl generic query/context boundary.

phases.name: Cloud todo Dactyl adapter
phases.description: Route backend=cloud todo commands through Propodus auth and Dactyl query/batch operations with local/protocol proof.

phases.name: Validation and publication
phases.description: Refresh living specs and governance artifacts, run local checks, publish one PR, and report hosted proof limits.
